app.title: RSS Feeds for Last.fm
app.author: Baljhin
app.description: A lightweight Node.js service that generates RSS feeds for a Last.fm user’s listening history, allowing integration with any RSS reader.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install`.
Use the provided CLI to fetch the last 50 scrobbles for a test account and verify the output RSS XML.
Start the HTTP server with `npm start` and perform a GET request to `/feed?user=testuser`.
Check that the RSS feed contains `<item>` elements with correct `<title>`, `<link>`, and `<pubDate>` fields.
Run a load test with 20 concurrent requests and confirm the service remains responsive.
